headline: Heavy rain leaves large parts of Dhaka waterlogged, disrupting life
summary: Torrential rainfall triggered by active monsoon conditions and a low-pressure system has submerged roads across the capital, causing severe traffic and transport shortages.
details: Heavy rainfall over the past two days has left large parts of Dhaka waterlogged, severely disrupting daily life for residents. Torrential rain began Tuesday afternoon and continued intermittently, submerging roads across several parts of the city.
caption:
Dhaka's roads are underwater again. Heavy monsoon rain has left the capital waterlogged, leaving commuters stranded and daily earners losing their income.

Heavy rainfall over the past two days has left large parts of Dhaka waterlogged, severely disrupting daily life for residents. Torrential rain began Tuesday afternoon and continued intermittently, submerging roads across several parts of the city.

headline: 39-year-old Messi rescues Argentina with magic strike after penalty miss
summary: Trailing 2-0 against Egypt, Lionel Messi overcame a missed penalty to produce a stunning trick shot that kept Argentina's World Cup dreams alive.
details: Argentina faced a critical moment in the World Cup after trailing 2-0 against Egypt. The team had not lost a World Cup match since 2022, but they were on the brink of elimination as time slipped away.
The pressure intensified for Lionel Messi, who had already missed a penalty in the match. Despite the setback, the 39-year-old talisman continued to fight as Argentina's backs were against the wall.
With only 11 minutes remaining, Messi produced a brilliant pass that bypassed seven defenders to find Cristian Romero, who scored the first goal to give Argentina hope.
Four minutes later, the magic happened. After a ball dropped to him on the edge of the box, Messi fired a high-pace trick shot that brushed the goalkeeper's hand and found the net.

Former teammates and legends like Zlatan Ibrahimovic and Thierry Henry have praised his performance, with Ibrahimovic calling him an 'animal' and Henry noting his ability to switch on and dominate the game.
The performance serves as a reminder of the team's reliance on Messi's individual brilliance when the team as a whole struggles to find inspiration.
caption:
A missed penalty and 2-0 down. How did 39-year-old Lionel Messi save Argentina?

Argentina faced a critical moment in the World Cup after trailing 2-0 against Egypt. The team had not lost a World Cup match since 2022, but they were on the brink of elimination as time slipped away.

The pressure intensified for Lionel Messi, who had already missed a penalty in the match. Despite the setback, the 39-year-old talisman continued to fight as Argentina's backs were against the wall.

With only 11 minutes remaining, Messi produced a brilliant pass that bypassed seven defenders to find Cristian Romero, who scored the first goal to give Argentina hope.

Four minutes later, the magic happened. After a ball dropped to him on the edge of the box, Messi fired a high-pace trick shot that brushed the goalkeeper's hand and found the net.

Former teammates and legends like Zlatan Ibrahimovic and Thierry Henry have praised his performance, with Ibrahimovic calling him an 'animal' and Henry noting his ability to switch on and dominate the game.

The performance serves as a reminder of the team's reliance on Messi's individual brilliance when the team as a whole struggles to find inspiration.

#Messi #Argentina #WorldCup #Football #LionelMessi

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, Prothom Alo
